-- First verify the OEI calculation makes sense
SELECT 
  pr.snapkey,
  om.maintcost + om.cleancost + om.replcost as total_op_cost,
  p.cap_mw * 1000 as rated_kw,
  CAST((om.maintcost + om.cleancost + om.replcost) AS numeric) / (CAST(p.cap_mw AS numeric) * 1000) as oei
FROM operational_metrics om
JOIN plant_record pr ON om.snapops = pr.snapkey
JOIN plants p ON pr.sitetie = p.sitekey
LIMIT 5;

  pr.snapkey,
  om.maintcost + om.cleancost + om.replcost as total_op_cost,
